verses.en: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.
verses.pt: Depois destas coisas o copeiro do rei do Egito e o seu padeiro ofenderam o seu senhor, o rei do Egito.
verses.en_web: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: Now after these things the chief servant who had the care of the wine, and the chief bread-maker in Pharaoh's house, did something against Pharaoh's orders;

verses.en: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.
verses.pt: Pelo que se indignou Faraó contra os seus dois oficiais, contra o copeiro-mor e contra o padeiro-mor;
verses.en_web: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.
verses.en_bbe: And Pharaoh was angry with his two servants, with the chief wine-servant and the chief bread-maker;

verses.en: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
verses.pt: e mandou detê-los na casa do capitão da guarda, no cárcere onde José estava preso;
verses.en_web: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
verses.en_bbe: And he put them in prison under the care of the captain of the army, in the same prison where Joseph himself was shut up.

verses.en: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.
verses.pt: e o capitão da guarda pô-los a cargo de José, que os servia. Assim estiveram por algum tempo em detenção.
verses.en_web: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.
verses.en_bbe: And the captain put them in Joseph's care, and he did what was needed for them; and they were kept in prison for some time.

verses.en: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.
verses.pt: Ora, tiveram ambos um sonho, cada um seu sonho na mesma noite, cada um conforme a interpretação do seu sonho, o copeiro e o padeiro do rei do Egito, que se achavam presos no cárcere:
verses.en_web: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.
verses.en_bbe: And these two had a dream on the same night; the chief wine-servant and the chief bread-maker of the king of Egypt, who were in prison, the two of them had dreams with a special sense.

verses.en: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.
verses.pt: Quando José veio a eles pela manhã, viu que estavam perturbados:
verses.en_web: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.
verses.en_bbe: And in the morning when Joseph came to them he saw that they were looking sad.

verses.en: And he asked Pharaoh’s officers that were with him in the ward of his lord’s house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?
verses.pt: Perguntou, pois, a esses oficiais de Faraó, que com ele estavam no cárcere da casa de seu senhor, dizendo: Por que estão os vossos semblantes tão tristes hoje?
verses.en_web: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to the servants of Pharaoh who were in prison with him, Why are you looking so sad?

verses.en: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them, I pray you.
verses.pt: Responderam-lhe: Tivemos um sonho e ninguém há que o interprete. Pelo que lhes disse José: Porventura não pertencem a Deus as interpretações? Contai-mo, peço-vos.
verses.en_web: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me.”
verses.en_bbe: Then they said to him, We have had a dream, and no one is able to give us the sense. And Joseph said, Does not the sense of dreams come from God? what was your dream?

verses.en: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;
verses.pt: Então contou o copeiro-mor o seu sonho a José, dizendo-lhe: Eis que em meu sonho havia uma vide diante de mim,
verses.en_web: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,
verses.en_bbe: Then the chief wine-servant gave Joseph an account of his dream, and said, In my dream I saw a vine before me;

verses.en: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:
verses.pt: e na vide três sarmentos; e, tendo a vide brotado, saíam as suas flores, e os seus cachos produziam uvas maduras.
verses.en_web: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes.
verses.en_bbe: And on the vine were three branches; and it seemed as if it put out buds and flowers, and from them came grapes ready for cutting.

verses.en: And Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.
verses.pt: O copo de Faraó estava na minha mão; e, tomando as uvas, eu as espremia no copo de Faraó e entregava o copo na mão de Faraó.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”
verses.en_bbe: And Pharaoh's cup was in my hand, and I took the grapes and crushing them into Pharaoh's cup, gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

verses.en: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:
verses.pt: Então disse-lhe José: Esta é a sua interpretação: Os três sarmentos são três dias;
verses.en_web: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.
verses.en_bbe: Then Joseph said, This is the sense of your dream: the three branches are three days;

verses.en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.
verses.pt: dentro de três dias Faraó levantará a tua cabeça, e te restaurará ao teu cargo; e darás o copo de Faraó na sua mão, conforme o costume antigo, quando eras seu copeiro.
verses.en_web: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.
verses.en_bbe: After three days Pharaoh will give you honour, and put you back into your place, and you will give him his cup as you did before, when you were his wine-servant.

verses.en: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:
verses.pt: Mas lembra-te de mim, quando te for bem; usa, peço-te, de compaixão para comigo e faze menção de mim a Faraó e tira-me desta casa;
verses.en_web: But remember me when it will be well with you, and please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.
verses.en_bbe: But keep me in mind when things go well for you, and be good to me and say a good word for me to Pharaoh and get me out of this prison:

verses.en: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.
verses.pt: porque, na verdade, fui roubado da terra dos hebreus; e aqui também nada tenho feito para que me pusessem na masmorra.
verses.en_web: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.”
verses.en_bbe: For truly I was taken by force from the land of the Hebrews; and I have done nothing for which I might be put in prison.

verses.en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:
verses.pt: Quando o padeiro-mor viu que a interpretação era boa, disse a José: Eu também sonhei, e eis que três cestos de pão branco estavam sobre a minha cabeça.
verses.en_web: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, “I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head.
verses.en_bbe: Now when the chief bread-maker saw that the first dream had a good sense, he said to Joseph, I had a dream; and in my dream there were three baskets of white bread on my head;

verses.en: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.
verses.pt: E no cesto mais alto havia para Faraó manjares de todas as qualidades que fazem os padeiros; e as aves os comiam do cesto que estava sobre a minha cabeça.
verses.en_web: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head.”
verses.en_bbe: And in the top basket were all sorts of cooked meats for Pharaoh; and the birds were taking them out of the baskets on my head.

verses.en: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:
verses.pt: Então respondeu José: Esta é a interpretação do sonho: Os três cestos são três dias;
verses.en_web: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.
verses.en_bbe: Then Joseph said, This is the sense of your dream: the three baskets are three days;

verses.en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.
verses.pt: dentro de três dias tirará Faraó a tua cabeça, e te pendurará num madeiro, e as aves comerão a tua carne de sobre ti.
verses.en_web: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you.”
verses.en_bbe: After three days Pharaoh will take you out of prison, hanging you on a tree, so that your flesh will be food for birds.

verses.en: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.
verses.pt: E aconteceu ao terceiro dia, o dia natalício de Faraó, que este deu um banquete a todos os seus servos; e levantou a cabeça do copeiro-mor, e a cabeça do padeiro-mor no meio dos seus servos;
verses.en_web: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he made a feast for all his servants, and he lifted up the head of the chief cup bearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants.
verses.en_bbe: Now the third day was Pharaoh's birthday, and he gave a feast for all his servants; and he gave honour to the chief wine-servant and the chief bread-maker among the others.

verses.en: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand:
verses.pt: e restaurou o copeiro-mor ao seu cargo de copeiro, e este deu o copo na mão de Faraó;
verses.en_web: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again, and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand;
verses.en_bbe: And he put the chief wine-servant back in his old place; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

verses.en: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.
verses.pt: mas ao padeiro-mor enforcou, como José lhes havia interpretado.
verses.en_web: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.
verses.en_bbe: But the chief bread-maker was put to death by hanging, as Joseph had said.

verses.en: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.
verses.pt: O copeiro-mor, porém, não se lembrou de José, antes se esqueceu dele.
verses.en_web: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.
verses.en_bbe: But the wine-servant did not keep Joseph in mind or give a thought to him.
